QuestInfo.name: Black Mage Laboratory
QuestInfo.0: #p1101002# wants to speak with you about something.
QuestInfo.1: A Black Mage Laboratory has been discovered at #m261000000#. Find out what's going on.
QuestInfo.2: One note in particular seems to contain some important information...

0.0: Kaiser... I know you are busy, but I have something to say.\r\n#L0##bWhat's the matter?#l\n#k
0.1: The Black Mage Laboratory has been discovered at #m261000000#. The investigation team has already completed their sweep, and found something you might be interested in. Would you like to hear about it?

yes.0: There were many interesting documents. We sent a copy on to Nova, but I wanted to show you this myself.

1.0: This is it...information about the Transcendents.
